name: DeSplat
definition: A method that decomposes the 3DGS scene representation into two distinct sets of Gaussian primitives: static scene Gaussians ($G_s$) and per-view distractor Gaussians ($G_d$), to separate static elements from transient distractors without external semantic features.
summary: DeSplat is a distractor-free novel view synthesis method that decomposes 3D Gaussian Splatting into static and per-view distractor primitives, enabling independent rendering without external semantic models.
